name: NBA 2K16 Vita v0.2
body:
# NBA 2K16 Vita v0.2

NBA 2K16 comes to PS Vita as an offline port of the Android game, with physical controls, optional rear-touch triggers, touchscreen menus, commentary, crowd and court audio, and local saves.

Quick Game, Blacktop, Season and MyCareer are available. See the known issues below for current limitations.

## Changes in v0.2

- Smoother settings-list scrolling, including access to the last Video Settings row.
- A fixed Vita graphics preset that prevents unsupported crowd and sideline options from being enabled accidentally.
- Improved cache handling under memory pressure to reduce gameplay hitches, with bounded recovery instead of a busy wait.
- Rear-touch L2/R2 disabled by default, with an optional configuration file to enable them. Physical L/R, sticks and front touch remain available. See [Controls](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/blob/v0.2/README.md#controls).
- Selected-folder IFF mods without replacing the original OBB, including native roster Save/Load workflows.
- VPK-only updates from prepared v0.1 installations; compatible graphics caches are retained.

## Download and install

**First install: choose `NBA2K16Vita_v0.2-setup.zip` from the release assets.** It contains the VPK, Windows data helper, graphics cache and offline instructions. No build tools or manual APK extraction are needed.

You need a homebrew-enabled Vita with VitaShell, `kubridge.skprx` and `libshacccg.suprx`; a Windows PC with Windows PowerShell 5.1; and your own **NBA 2K16 Android 0.0.29 ARMv7 APK** plus the matching **`main.29.com.t2ksports.nba2k16android.obb`** (2,127,425,536 bytes). Have at least 3 GB free on the PC for preparation and 3 GB free on `ux0:`, with additional room for saves and caches.

1. Extract the entire setup ZIP to a writable local Windows folder and run **`Prepare NBA 2K16 Data.bat`**.
2. Select your APK and OBB. Wait for **`READY TO COPY`**.
3. Copy the **contents** of `NBA 2K16 Vita Prepared\ux0\` to `ux0:` using VitaShell USB or FTP.
4. For USB transfers, safely eject the Vita drive on the PC and press **Circle in VitaShell** to leave USB mode. Install **`ux0:NBA2K16Vita_v0.2.vpk`**, then launch **NBA 2K16**.

Read the [installation guide](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/blob/v0.2/docs/INSTALLING.md) for plugin setup, folder examples and troubleshooting. The setup ZIP includes `START_HERE.txt`. A macOS/Linux preparation helper is not included.

Downloading the release and installing missing Vita dependencies can require internet access. Preparing your game files and playing are offline.

**Other APK packaging:** accepted if all five required ARMv7 libraries match the supported build. Other native game versions and different OBB data are untested and unsupported in v0.2. The helper checks contents automatically; a matching filename alone is not enough.

## Release assets

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| [`NBA2K16Vita_v0.2-setup.zip`](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/releases/v0.2/downloads/NBA2K16Vita_v0.2-setup.zip) | Recommended first install: VPK, Windows helper, graphics cache and instructions. |
| [`NBA2K16Vita_v0.2.vpk`](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/releases/v0.2/downloads/NBA2K16Vita_v0.2.vpk) | Application only, for an update or already-prepared data. |
| [`nba2k16-vita-v0.2-source.zip`](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/releases/v0.2/downloads/nba2k16-vita-v0.2-source.zip) | Matching source and build instructions for developers. |
| [`SHA256SUMS.txt`](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/releases/v0.2/downloads/SHA256SUMS.txt) | SHA-256 checksums for the release downloads, including optional starter mods. |

The downloads do not include an APK, OBB or original Android game libraries. A prepared graphics cache is included. Supply your own legally obtained game files.

## Known issues

- Crowd and sideline rendering can show corrupted colors and cause audio dropouts or stalls. v0.2 keeps these options Off with a fixed graphics preset

- Blacktop can intermittently freeze after confirming **Quit then Yes**. If it stays frozen, press PS, close NBA 2K16 from its LiveArea, and reopen the app
- Brief hitches can occur during games. Replays can run slowly
- Game loading and some menu transitions, including opening Quick Game, can be slow. The included graphics cache reduces first-use loading; uncached content can take longer
- A team logo can be missing from the Season calendar. Some net effects can be missed

## Graphics settings

v0.2 fixes Stadium and Player to **Ultra Low**, with Reflection, Shadow, Crowd and Sideline **Off**. Video Settings remains available for viewing, but its values cannot be changed. Crowd audio remains enabled. Optional graphics can return after their rendering and performance issues are resolved.

## Updating and reporting problems

Back up **`ux0:data/nba2k16/internal/`**, then install the newer VPK over the old one. Keep the game-data folder and saves; re-prepare data only when release notes ask you to.

v0.2 reuses the existing cache: an already prepared v0.1 installation needs only the newer VPK. Keep installed mods and both cache directories. A fresh installation uses the complete setup ZIP.

Each subfolder in `ux0:data/nba2k16/mods/` is one mod pack; `active.txt` selects the one folder to load. A pack can contain one replacement or a collection. To use mods together, combine compatible files in one simple pack or use the combined starter package. See [Modding](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/blob/main/docs/MODDING.md#how-mod-packs-work) for examples and setup. Desktop editing and mod management in 2KVenueLAB are separate from the port release.

Report problems through [GitLab Issues](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/issues), including the port version, Vita model, mode, steps to reproduce and any error message. Include `loader.log` if available, after checking it for personal information. Do not upload game files or saves.

Project direction and hardware testing: **SpliffCurryBeats**. Thanks to the soloader, VitaGL, FalsoJNI, FalsoNDK, OpenSL ES, FAAD2 and Vita homebrew contributors. See the [README](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/blob/v0.2/README.md) for controls, credits and licenses. This project is not affiliated with 2K or Sony.

## Optional starter mods

- [Native ABA ball over the NBA ball](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/releases/v0.2/downloads/starter_aba.zip).
- [LA Fitness over Rooftop Blacktop](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/releases/v0.2/downloads/starter_la_fitness.zip).
- [Both replacements together](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/releases/v0.2/downloads/starter_aba_la_fitness.zip).

Extract the selected package and follow the [mod installation guide](https://gitlab.com/sexcurrybeats/nba2k16-vita/-/blob/main/docs/MODDING.md#starter-mods). Only one mod folder is selected at a time; use the combined package for both replacements. Starter mods are optional and contain no roster changes.

name: 1.0.0 — Release
body:
Release 1.0 with OFF, SIMPLE and DETAIL single-screen modes.

## Changes

- Fixed the post-credits save-scene descriptor and restored the cleared-game save flow, Theater Mode and Zero Gear unlock path.
- Added linked-ELF validation and diagnostic logging for the ending save scene.
- Fixed the mostly black display that could occur after pausing and resuming the final Riku battle.
- Fixed the brief widescreen 4:3 HUD corruption when opening the L shortcut.
- Fixed the temporary stretched Darkside tentacle geometry in Holo-Mission: Two Keys.
- Extended the pause dim overlay across the widescreen side borders, including cutscene menus with Continue / Skip.
- Added three single-screen choices: OFF, SIMPLE and DETAIL.
- SIMPLE uses static panels with fewer 2D texture effects and filters for better performance.
- DETAIL keeps richer HUD composition, detailed 2D filtering and effects for a more immersive experience at a higher rendering cost.
- Added mode-change logging and optimized DETAIL by skipping smoothing for pixels discarded by HUD masks.

## Performance findings

The supplied performance log contains menu transitions, scene changes and different layouts, so it does not provide a controlled OFF/SIMPLE/DETAIL comparison. CPU percentages are thread-group measurements, not total hardware utilization, and GPU completion time is not a direct utilization percentage.

The existing port already requests the configured maximum clocks. Increasing thread activity to 100% would not guarantee more frames and could harm audio and synchronization. The log now records the effective clocks for verification.

## Validation

- Native Vita build completed successfully.
- Post-link ending-scene check passed.
- Composition, ending-link and GX3D host tests passed.
- The VPK archive passed integrity validation.
- Real Vita testing is still required for performance and the cutscene Continue / Skip overlay.

## Test procedure

Use the same mission, resolution, HUD and filter settings. Warm the DETAIL shader cache once, then test OFF, SIMPLE and DETAIL for at least 20 seconds each with the menu closed. Repeat with debug logging disabled. During a cutscene, test Continue and Skip in all three modes and confirm that the side borders dim and return to normal after closing the pause menu.

name: Raging Thunder Vita — v1.0.1
body:
# Raging Thunder Vita — v1.0.1

Bug-fix release based on tester reports.

## Fixes

- **Race controls**: Cross accelerates, Square brakes, Triangle fires the nitro,
  R/L accelerate/brake. (Before, Cross was nitro and Square/Triangle did nothing:
  Raging Thunder 1 never remaps the engine's generic key masks, so the port now
  does it at boot.)
- **Start pauses reliably**: the back key is now held for 6 frames instead of 1,
  which the game sometimes missed.
- **Lighting / shadows**: lit objects (track, cars) no longer flash to another
  mesh's lighting. Fixed in vendored vitaGL: an unlit draw consumed the
  matrix-changed flag without recomputing the normal matrix.
- **Start + Select menu**: no input lag; the overlay is redrawn only when something changes.

## Controls (default)

| Vita | Race | Menus |
|---|---|---|
| ✕ Cross / R | Accelerate | — (does nothing) |
| ■ Square / L | Brake / reverse | L/R switch page |
| ▲ Triangle | Nitro | **OK / confirm** |
| ● Circle / Start | Pause | Back |
| D-Pad / left stick | Steer | Navigate |
| Start + Select | PS Vita controls menu | |

> If you already have a `controls.txt` from v1.0.0, it keeps your bindings;
> the new race actions apply to whatever buttons are bound to ACCELERATE / BRAKE / NITRO.

## Install / update

Install `ragingthunder.vpk` over v1.0.0 with VitaShell. Game files
(`ux0:data/ragingthunder/main.so`, `assets/data.vfs`) and saves are kept.
First install: see `LEEME.txt` or the README.

name: Street Fighter IV CE Vita v1.0-rc3
body:
Adds controller navigation to menus and restores the Android file-buffer cache used by Ultra cinematics.

## Changes

- Navigate menus with a visible pointer: D-pad or left stick to move, Cross to click/drag, and Circle to go back. Touch takes priority; the pointer is hidden during combat and system keyboard entry.
- Dismiss Android's unavailable quit confirmation when Circle is pressed on Main, preventing the menu from waiting indefinitely. Use the Vita system UI to exit.
- Restore the original shared-buffer file cache and its reset callback. A repeated Ryu Ultra test now makes 2 complete movie-file reads instead of 132 for the same 132 requests, without allocating another movie buffer. This removes verified redundant I/O; confirmation that it resolves the reported entry/exit pauses on physical Vita is still pending.
- Extend optional `debug_timing=1` diagnostics with scene/camera transitions, slow frames and readback timing.
- Document the complete asset requirements for the 32-character roster and validate them independently of savedata.

## Unlocking the roster

**You do not need an unlocked savedata, an unlock code, or a configuration switch.** The loader enables all 32 characters when the complete local pack from your own matching Android copy passes its file checks.

Copy the full `assets/` and `demand_assets/` directories, including the original `_filelist.txt`, downloaded character data and required `.obm`, `.bin` and `.idx` files. The base APK or selection portraits alone may be incomplete. If only four characters appear, check `ux0:data/sf4ce/boot.log` and the [README requirements](https://github.com/frangarcj/sf4ce_vita/blob/v1.0-rc3/README.md#unlocking-all-32-characters), restore missing files, and restart. Keep your existing save.

## Validation

- [GitHub Actions build and validation](https://github.com/frangarcj/sf4ce_vita/actions/runs/38968358810): host regression tests with ASan/UBSan, VitaSDK build, and VPK content validation. The attached VPK is this CI artifact and was tested in Vita3K.
- Vita3K checks cover controller menu navigation, Options/Back, repeated cancellation on Main followed by training, Ryu Ultra cinematics, return to combat, and pause/continuation.
- Isolated roster checks: fresh save plus complete pack = 32 selectable characters; fresh save without pack activation = 4; existing save without pack activation = 4. Original saves and executable were restored with hashes unchanged.
- Physical Vita performance and the reported cinematic pauses still need confirmation. This remains a test candidate.

## Installation and upgrade

Install `SF4CE.vpk` using VitaShell. Existing game data stays in `ux0:data/sf4ce/`; deleting your save is not required. Prerequisites remain kubridge, FdFix (unless using rePatch), and `libshacccg.suprx`.

A legally obtained ARMv7 Android 1.05.00 copy and its matching libraries/data are required. **No APK, Android libraries, game assets, music or video are included.** Offline-service and Vita3K compatibility limitations from [v1.0-rc1](https://github.com/frangarcj/sf4ce_vita/releases/tag/v1.0-rc1) still apply. `SHA256SUMS` verifies the attached VPK; matching loader source is available in this release's tag/source archives.

# 

Native port of **Hero of Sparta HD Free v1.1.4** (Gameloft, Android) to PS Vita / PS TV.
Title ID: `PSVHOS001` · Version: `01.00` · Build: **Release** (`PORT_TRACE=OFF`, no debug log).

## Download

- `heroofsparta.vpk` (in `build/heroofsparta.vpk`, ~1.1 MB) — contains the Release eboot + LiveArea.
- Game data is **not** included (see Installation).

## Installation

1. Console requirements: CFW (HENkaku / h-encore / Enso, 3.60–3.74), **kubridge** +
   **FdFix** plugins in `ur0:tai/config.txt` (`*KERNEL`), and **libshacccg.suprx**
   in `ur0:data/`.
2. Install `heroofsparta.vpk` with VitaShell.
3. Copy into `ux0:data/heroofsparta/` from your legally obtained APK + Android data:
   - `lib/armeabi/libheroofsparta.so` → `ux0:data/heroofsparta/libheroofsparta.so`
   - `assets/data.save` → `ux0:data/heroofsparta/assets/data.save`
   - `res/*` → `ux0:data/heroofsparta/res/`
   - Android data folder `hos/` → `ux0:data/heroofsparta/hos/`
4. Launch **Hero of Sparta** from the LiveArea. The first load takes a few minutes
   (texture decompression); later loads are faster.

Final layout in `ux0:data/heroofsparta/`:
`libheroofsparta.so`, `hos/`, `res/`, `assets/data.save`, `saves/` (auto-created),
`logs/` (Debug builds only).

## Performance (v1.0)

- Game locked to **30 FPS** (the engine advances its logic per frame; uncapped it
  would run fast-forward). Menu at 60, ingame stable 30; very busy scenes
  (~500 draws/frame) can dip to ~22 FPS.
- PVRTC textures uploaded **natively to the GPU** (no software decoding).
- Vita clocks at max from boot (ARM 444 / BUS 222 / GPU 222).
- Audio (96 SFX + 16 music tracks) preloaded/decoded off the main thread;
  music streams.
- The Release build produces no per-frame logging: verified that the eboot
  contains zero debug strings (`l_debug`/`l_info`/`l_warn` compile to nothing).
  Play with the Release VPK; the Debug build is for diagnostics only.

## Saves — verified ✔

- Android paths are remapped: `/data/data/<package>/*.dat` → `saves/` inside
  `ux0:data/heroofsparta/`. The `saves/` folder is created automatically at boot.
- Confirmed with a real console log (`logs/heroofsparta_011.log`):
  reads of `Spartan.dat`/`Setting.dat` at boot and **correct writes**
  (`Spartan0.dat`, `Spartan.dat` opened `wb`, `fopen` OK + `fclose` OK, no errors).
  Progress persists across sessions.
- If a save ever failed, the Debug log would show it as `fopen(...): (nil)`;
  no such case to date.

## Controls

| Vita input | Action |
|---|---|
| Left / right stick / D-Pad | Drag the virtual joystick |
| Cross | Sword (dismisses the dialog box when one is open) |
| Circle | Shield |
| Triangle | Focused kill |
| Start | Android MENU (pause) |
| START + SELECT | Quit to LiveArea |
| Front touch | Original 1:1 controls, multitouch |

## 🛠️ Known issue (only one tracked)

- **Physical buttons**: currently the **only tracked issue, work in progress**
  (the pad injects touches onto the HUD touch zones read live from the engine;
  if a button ever seems to miss, the Debug log shows exactly where the
  synthetic tap landed). No other open issues for v1.0: the intro video
  (`intro.vdo`) is skipped by design and the HUD is drawn at full opacity
  on purpose.

name: v1.2.0: new controls (no more touchscreen), PS TV / DualShock support, sharper HUD
body:
Thanks again for all the reports! This update is mostly about the controls: no more touchscreen, every move is on a real button now.

**New controls**
The Vita now uses the original Xbox layout. The Xbox pad also has only two triggers, so nothing is lost:
- **L**: spin left in the air. On the ground: nollie (tap again for pressure). Revert when you land on a ramp. On foot: reset the camera.
- **R**: spin right in the air. On the ground: switch stance. Revert when you land on a ramp. On foot: hold to grab ledges and ladders.
- **L + R** in the air: spine transfer, acid drop.
- **SELECT**: get off the board, and back on (#34).
- The touchscreen and the rear touchpad aren't used anymore. You can rest your fingers anywhere (#7, #21).
- The button prompts in menus, goals and editors now show L, R and SELECT instead of PS2 buttons the Vita doesn't have.

**PS TV and external controllers (#9)**
Options > Control Setup > Vita Options > Controller > **DualShock**: L1, L2, R1, R2, L3 and R3 work like on a PS2. For the PS TV, a DS3/DS4/DualSense with a plugin, or trigger grips on the rear touchpad (left half = L2, right half = R2).

**Vita Options, cleaned up**
Controller (PS Vita / DualShock), Camera Up/Down, Camera Left/Right, Skater Up/Down (normal / inverted), Frame Rate (60 / 30 fps). The old touch settings in `controls.txt` are ignored.

**Sharper HUD**
The score panel, special bar, balance meter, stance icons (switch, nollie...), trick text and menu theme icons now use the HD redraws made by the THUG Pro team. Same layout as before, just sharper. Nothing to install, it's in the VPK. Thanks to the THUG Pro team!

**Fixes**
- **Moscow:** the tanks don't pop in anymore (#36).
- **LAN Play** no longer crashes the game. LAN and online aren't supported, so the menu entry just does nothing for now (#37).
- **Videos:** the game could freeze for good when a video started without sound (the demo videos on the main menu, or after a goal). It now plays the video silently instead. This may also fix the crash after the first Muska contest (#25).
- **Create-a-Park:** zoom works again (SELECT to zoom in, SELECT + R to zoom out), L/R lower and raise the floor.

**About other reports**
- **Air transfer 70 ft (#35):** same rule as the original game. The air only counts while you're in vert air: pushing forward in the air breaks it, and bailing cancels it.
- **Rail locks (#37):** the grind code is the same as on Xbox. If you play at 30 fps, rails can be a little harder to catch.
- **Stuck on "Quit?" (#33):** I couldn't reproduce it. If it happens to you, please tell me the level and what you were doing on the issue.

**Installing**
Install `thug_vita.vpk` over your current version with VitaShell. Your saves are kept.

name: v.1.5
body:
- Added PGXP support for perspective correction of texture warping and geometry wobbling. Geometry wobbling fix is not available on PSVita.
- Added post-processing effects support (CRT, Sharp Bilinear, Sepia, Grayscale, Negative and many more).
- Fixed a bug making the Discord Rich Presence not show custom racers names and instead using the original overloaded ones.
- Fixed a bug causing custom racers portrait to have incorrect background trasparency and incorrect aspect ratio/scaling.
- Fixed a bug casuing custom racers overloading Penta Penguin to show an incorrect stats chart at character selection screen.
- Added shadow casting for the stats chart in the character selection screen.
- Fixed a bug causing custom racers models to persist across modes, resulting sometimes in custom racers to be used in place of original ones erroneously.
- Fixed the track previews to have incorrect aspect ratio.
- Fixed the track previews to have incorrect blending and showing as darker than normal.
- Added sampled sounds support for custom racers (Needs racers packs regeneration).
- Fixed a bug causing Wumpa fruits to be visible in the end race screen after a VS/Battle race.
- Added replay stopping, replay frame-by-frame progression and replay playback speed adjustments controls in the Ghost Replay mode.
- Fixed Boss Battle boss voices to be overridden by custom racer ones under certain circumstances.
- Add support for mask and wheels settings for custom racers during pack generation.
- Allow player 2/3/4 to be able to change the racers page during character selection.
- Made so that it's now possible for all players to pick same characters in the character selection during multiplayer modes.
- Added Exit Game option in the main menu.
- Switched Exit and Options voices in the Pause menu so that now Exit is the last voice in the pause menu.
- [PC/Web] Made so that a dualshock is shown for the inputs overlay during Ghost Replay.
- Added Audio options in the Options submenu in the main menu.
- Reworked the Language submenu to use smaller font for a cleaner presentation.
- Changed AI Racers option to allow for AI Racers to pick only original extra characters or original + custom ones.
- Fixed a bug causing SFX mixups during multiplayer modes when using custom racers.
- [Web] Enforce an opaque framebuffer for the OpenGL context: Fixes the game being a black screen on Mac.
- Fixed an out of bound causing a crash when playing in 3P or 4P modes on Mystery Caves.
- [PSVita] Updated Livearea assets.

homebrew_description: Loader for the classic PopCap game Insaniquarium! Deluxe for the PS Vita. Feed your fish, collect coins, and fight aliens! (Note: Game data files from the original PC release are required).
homebrew_long_description:
A PlayStation Vita port of Insaniquarium! Deluxe.
Not affiliated with PopCap, EA or Sony.

Loads the Android libmain.so (armeabi-v7a) of Insaniquarium directly on a PS Vita: maps it into memory, relocates it against Vita-side replacements for libc/SDL/GL, runs its C++ constructors and calls SDL_main. Plays the PopCap (and optional SOE) intro videos on launch. The first line of log.txt shows the loader version.

Credit to kyle-sylvestre for the Android version of the game, which is a fork off of Vindirect's original WinFin decompilation. This build acts as a loader for the libmain.so library from the Android v0.1 release, adding custom button mappings. Future bug fix development for the PlayStation Vita version of the game will be separate to keep code/asset files as efficient as possible. Credit to rinnegatamante for vitaGL.

This repository contains no game files. You need your own copy of the game.

Install Instructions:
Find the Insanquarium! Deluxe folder on your PC/Mac.
On Mac the path is: '/Users/***/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Insaniquarium Deluxe'
On PC the path is: 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Insaniquarium Deluxe'
Copy the folder to your PS Vita using a FTP or USB transfer into 'ux0:data/'
Rename the folder to 'insaniquarium'
Note: not all the files are required, but the total size is 13.7MB so it's convenient to copy it all.
Have fun! The game will play at 36 fps without overclocking.



Controls & Features

Touchscreen:	Feed your fish, collect coins, fight aliens, tap basically anything! Acts as a left click through the whole game.
Rear Touchscreen:	Useful for feeding fish and fighting aliens. (Harder to collect coins)
X BUTTON:	Tap on the glass...
SQUARE:	Bubbles!!! Linked to "B"
TRIANGLE:	Opens the Presto Change-O menu. (Functions the same as as right-clicking Presto on PC)
CIRCLE:	A basic navigation/back button.
L/R BUTTONS:	Cycle through menu/help/story pages.
START:	Pauses the game. Linked to "space"
D-PAD UP:	Hold down to open the keyboard. (Hold for at least 1500ms)
CHEATS: Enter with ALL LOWERCASE letters using the keyboard.
WARNING: Do not attempt to open the keyboard while the game is paused. This causes a softlock.

name: ScummVM 2026.4.0 "Never-slop"
body:
It is hard to believe, but a quarter-century and a couple of days ago, the ScummVM Project saw its first public commit by Ludvig Strigeus aka ludde.

So many things have changed, and we continue to follow our new release cadence. Without further ado, let's discuss what is coming with the 2026.4.0 release.

## New games:
   - Added support for Mortadelo y Filemón: Una Aventura de Cine Edición Original.
   - Added support for Mortadelo y Filemón: Dos vaqueros chapuceros.
   - Added support for Mortadelo y Filemón: Terror, Espanto y Pavor.
   - Added support for Mortadelo y Filemón: La Sexta Secta.
   - Added support for Mortadelo y Filemón: Operación Moscú.
   - Added support for Mortadelo y Filemón: El Escarabajo de Cleopatra.
   - Added support for Mortadelo y Filemón: La Banda de Corvino.
   - Added support for Mortadelo y Filemón: Balones y Patadones.
   - Added support for Mortadelo y Filemón: Mamelucos a la Romana.
   - Added support for Dracula: Resurrection.
   - Added support for Dracula 2: The Last Sanctuary.
   - Added support for Amerzone: The Explorer's Legacy.
   - Added support for The Cameron Files: The Secret at Loch Ness.
   - Added support for The Messenger / Louvre: The Final Curse.
   - Added support for Nancy Drew: The Secret of Shadow Ranch.
   - Added support for Nancy Drew: Curse of Blackmoor Manor.
   - Added support for Nancy Drew: Secret of the Old Clock.
   - Added support for Nancy Drew: Last Train to Blue Moon Canyon.
   - Added support for Nancy Drew: Danger by Design.
   - Added support for Nancy Drew: The Creature of Kapu Cave.
   - Added support for Chamber of the Sci-Mutant Priestess.
   - Added support for Star Wars: Rebel Assault.
   - Added support for Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire.
   - Added support for Dragonsphere.
   - Added support for Return of the Phantom.
   - Added support for Once Upon a Forest.
   - Added support for Alpha Polaris.
   - Added support for Art of Murder: FBI Confidential.
   - Added support for Barrow Hill - The Dark Path.
   - Added support for Dark Fall: Lost Souls.
   - Added support for Devil In The Capital.
   - Added support for Dirty Split.
   - Added support for Face Noir.
   - Added support for Ghost in the Sheet.
   - Added support for Hamlet.
   - Added support for The Lost Crown - A Ghost-Hunting Adventure.
   - Added support for Murder In Tehran's Alleys 2016.
   - Added support for Murder In Tehran's Alleys 1933.
   - Added support for Reversion series.
   - Added support for Rhiannon: Curse of the Four Branches.
   - Added support for Shadows on the Vatican series.
   - Added support for other Wintermute engine games, over 140 titles.
   - Added support for Der Schatz im Silbersee (Treasure of the Silver Lake).
   - Added support for The Fool's Errand.
   - Added support for Harvester.
   - Added support for Lord Avalot d'Argent.
   - Added support for Dungeon Master.
   - Added support for Eagle Eye Mysteries.
   - Added support for Eagle Eye Mysteries in London.

## General:
   - Optimised mixing and rate converters, for better performance.
   - Implemented ImGui-based interface for the Event Recorder.
   - Fixed bug with inability to specify game overrides for MIDI and MT-32
     devices.
   - Switched Nuked-OPL3 AdLib emulator to Nuked-OPL3-fast fork.
   - Added support for "obfuscated" InstallShield files. This mainly affected
     certain Nancy Drew games, that can now be run without having to run the
     Windows installer first.

## Asylum:
   - Fixed missing or incorrect walking sounds in some scenes.

## AWE:
   - Fix sound code crash in OpenBSD.

## Bagel:
   - Fix saving options for Hodj n' Podj's Th Gesng Gme.

## GLK:
   - Fixed saved font selections not being applied correctly in some games.
   - Added support for loading ZX Spectrum games directly from TAP/TZX tape images.

## Freescape:
   - Added support for loading ZX Spectrum games directly from TAP/TZX tape images.

## Hopkins:
   - Added the missing underwater base 3D first-person shooter.
   - Optional quality-of-life HUD for underwater base shooter with map and autopilot.

## Kyra:
   - Added support for Korean fan-translation of kyra1 (added in 2026.3.0).
   - Restored non-Korean kyra1 games which got broken ("You're missing the 'KYRA.DAT'
     engine data file or it got corrupted..." message).
   - Added an optional automap overlay for Eye of the Beholder 1 and 2.

## Lure:
   - Improved character pathfinding.
   - Fix being unable to talk to characters after a one-sided conversation.

## M4:
   - Numerous Riddle of Master Lu fixes for crashes, missing functionality, and game bugs.
   - Fixed original game bug where conversations with Wolf could freeze the game.
   - Added original game cheat codes for bypassing the maze.
   - Added translation of message log entries.

## MM:
   - Fix multiple M&M1 classic combat crashes.
   - Implement M&M1 classic PC speaker sound.
   - Fix stale view close handling causing crash.
   - Fix M&M1 spelling mistakes.
   - Improved M&M1 Enhanced mouse support, character generation, and general in-game UI.
   - Fixed cutscene subtitle rendering.
   - Added Xeen French translation.
   - Fix Pharaoh voice line repeating in Dark Side of Xeen intro.

## NANCY:
   - Generic flags are no longer cleared when saving or auto-saving. Clearing
     them introduced issues when auto-saving was done in some scenes.
   - Loading from the GMM is now possible before starting a new scene.
   - It's now possible to skip cutscenes and dialog lines with escape.
   - Mouse wheel functionality has been added to several UI widgets.
   - Fixed issues with the memory puzzle in Nancy9.
   - Fixed issues with the "I can't" item sound.
   - Answers entered in password kind of puzzles are now more forgiving (e.g.
     "Xoc" and "Lady Xoc" are now both acceptable answers).

## SCUMM:
   - Improved cursor scale in early Windows HE games.
   - Added option to use PAL timing for SID audio in C64 games. This slows
     down the music, but that's how many non-US players would have heard it.

## Sherlock:
   - Vertical movement delta fix for Rose Tattoo.

## SLUDGE:
   - Added detection for Shape-Shift Escape.

## TsAGE:
   - Added General MIDI and MT-32 support to the games.
   - Improved Sound Blaster sample playback.
   - Sound is properly paused when the engine is paused.

## V-Cruise:
   - Fixed time-based puzzles sometimes getting stuck after restarting ScummVM.

## Voyeur:
   - Match original first person movement with mouse when looking at mansion.

## Android port:
   - Support Android 17.
   - Add TTS support.
   - Add external MIDI device support.

## Atari port:
   - Added integration with nFM library.

# Merged Pull Requests
* PHOENIXVR: Add Dracula Resurrection variants by @Scorpeg in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7589
* DIRECTOR: Seed RNG from system time instead of a fixed value by @zberry92 in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7584
* AUDIO: Optimise mixing and rate converters by @mikrosk in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7385
* AUDIO : Atari TOS hardware / software OPL2 / 3 (YM262 / YM3812) by @n0kturnal in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7405
* DM: Fix Crashes and logical bugs  by @mohitbankar in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7592
* GUI: Add ImGui interface for Event Recorder by @1SHAMAY1 in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7555
* AUDIO: Change asound_fm.h include by @tunnelsociety in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7583
* CHAMBER: Week3 fixes by @11-andy-11 in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7586
* GUI: Fix MIDI / MT-32 device selection in Game Options override by @Kartik257354 in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7588
* DIRECTOR: work on XTRAs for Terzio & Tivola games by @Lariaa in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7590
* GUI: Fix bitmap rendering with RGB332 overlays by @ccawley2011 in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7593
* FREESCAPE: Move the sound code into separate classes by @ccawley2011 in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7256
* BLADERUNNER: Improve pixel format handling by @ccawley2011 in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7485
* SCI: Add detection for the Hebrew fanmade translation of KQ1-SCI> by @SegMash in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7600
* SCUMM: Add detection for Indiana Jones and the Quest for Paradise VGA by @einstein95 in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7602
* AUDIO: Atari TOS hardware / software OPL2 / 3 (YM262 / YM3812) by @n0kturnal in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7604
* BACKENDS: HAIKU: Add option to build dynamic plugins for Haiku by @Begasus in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7606
* NETWORKING/EMSCRIPTEN: Rewrite networking to use timers and add custom timer and mixer  by @chkuendig in https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/pull/7004

homebrew_description: Maniac Mansion Virtual Machine emulator.

This download is the latest stable release. ScummVM is a program which allows you to run certain classic graphical point-and-click adventure games, provided you already have their data files.
ScummVM supports many adventure games, including LucasArts SCUMM games (such as Monkey Island 1-3, Day of the Tentacle, Sam & Max, ...), many of Sierra's AGI and SCI games (such as King's Quest 1-6, Space Quest 1-5, ...), Discworld 1 and 2, Simon the Sorcerer 1 and 2, Beneath A Steel Sky, Lure of the Temptress, Broken Sword 1 and 2, Flight of the Amazon Queen, Gobliiins 1-3, The Legend of Kyrandia 1-3, many of Humongous Entertainment's children's SCUMM games (including Freddi Fish and Putt Putt games) and many more.

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.

A heavily AI-assisted port of the Android version of **Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse**.

- Prepared shader cache included in the VPK; no separate cache download.
- Faster loading, physical controls, and custom LiveArea artwork.

Known issues: some level music is missing, library jelly objects can disappear, and heavier areas can drop to around 20 FPS.

name: Dragon Ball Tap Battle PS Vita v1.2
body:
## Dragon Ball Tap Battle PS Vita v1.2 — PS Vita Controls

Play with the PS Vita's physical controls while keeping the gameplay view clear. This update retains v1.1's universal mod support and resource/memory improvements.

### What's new

- **Physical combat controls with hidden touch pads.** Move with the D-pad or left stick, attack with the face buttons, and use L/R for Rage and charged Ki attacks.
- **Choose your input before opening a profile:** **PS VITA CONTROLS** first, or **TOUCH ONLY** second. The launcher remembers each profile's last highlighted choice.
- **Character selection:** D-pad left/right changes characters; **X** confirms a ready character.
- **Pause and Back:** **Start** pauses and resumes from the main pause menu. **Circle** goes back when the original Back button is available.
- **English launcher** and an English controls reference.

![PS Vita controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VegettoSan/Drag-n-Ball-Tap-Battle-PS-Vita/f6997c7c753a4167065b32eeaefe3f8258d9ef70/docs/assets/vita-controls-en.png)

Combat actions depend on the character and original game requirements. **Dialogues, tutorials and other touch-only choices still use the front touchscreen.**

### Downloads

- **VPK:** install or update the Vita application with VitaShell.
- **Windows extractor ZIP:** prepare an APK as a standalone Vita profile on Windows 10/11.

The ZIP contains **Windows Extractor 1.5**, packaged for this release. Its extraction code and `profiles-v1` data layout are unchanged. It needs only built-in Windows PowerShell 5.1; no Python, Java or 7-Zip installation is required.

### Installation and upgrading

1. Install the VPK with VitaShell. It updates the stable application: **APP_VER `01.02` / TITLE_ID `DBTB01178`**.
2. **Keep existing profiles and saves.** Valid profiles do not need re-extraction for v1.2.
3. For a new APK, extract the entire Windows ZIP, keep its files together, and drag the APK onto `Extract_APK_for_Vita.bat`.
4. Copy the generated **data** folder to the root of `ux0:`. The final path must be `ux0:data/DBTapBattle/profiles/<Profile>/`. Keep any `dbtb_codec.json` with that profile.
5. Launch the game, choose a profile, then select **PS VITA CONTROLS** or **TOUCH ONLY**.

A homebrew-enabled PS Vita and working `libshacccg.suprx` are required. The VPK and extractor contain **no original APK or playable game data**; prepare data from your own compatible APK.

No Windows PC? Use the [Web Extractor](https://vegettosan.github.io/Drag-n-Ball-Tap-Battle-PS-Vita/).

[Full installation guide](https://github.com/VegettoSan/Drag-n-Ball-Tap-Battle-PS-Vita/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION_AND_EXTRACTION.md) · [Controls reference](https://github.com/VegettoSan/Drag-n-Ball-Tap-Battle-PS-Vita/blob/main/docs/VITA_CONTROLS_REFERENCE.md)

### Compatibility and validation

The retained controls were approved in earlier real-Vita tests; the exact rebuilt v1.2 package is still awaiting its own hardware test result. Not every community mod or menu is verified.

Heavy mod textures may appear softer because v1.1's adaptive texture quality policy remains in place to avoid GPU memory exhaustion.

Experimental controls builds use a separate bubble/save. Their `save-controls-test.bin` is not automatically transferred to the stable profile's `save.bin`.

This is the full-engine local build, prepared without dispatching a release workflow. Build source: `f6e9adaa792d38c4f3a7c7b27d112ae54b41ede5`.

[Build provenance](https://github.com/VegettoSan/Drag-n-Ball-Tap-Battle-PS-Vita/blob/main/docs/evidence/vita_release_1.2.json)

### SHA-256

The files retain these checksums even if their filenames are shortened:

**VPK**
```text
343aee505f77fa743339111fa7cf29f1e9bda333e49bddb6be166933d7bac1fc
```

**Windows extractor ZIP**
```text
b367d4dfac9da9b63f7e7ade7b57e8a45214ce7a30b104ddbcc0a76fdd24f64b
```

name: Smash Melee 0.8.16 (Vita + PS5)
body:
- [ ] ## Changes in Vita v0.8.16

This release adds a brand-new **PlayStation 5 version** alongside the Vita
version. Both share the same version number from now on.

### New: PS5 version (experimental)

- Smash Melee now runs on **jailbroken PS5 consoles** as a homebrew app. You
  still need your own `GALE01.iso`. Download `SmashMeleePS5-0.8.16.zip`, and
  see `PS5-README.md` for install steps.
- Menus run at a smooth 60 FPS, and matches stay close to 60 FPS.
- **Up to 4 players** on one PS5. Each controller needs to be signed in to a
  PS5 user; guest users work.
- A new **PS5 Options** menu lets you remap buttons, raise the picture quality
  (render resolution up to 4K) and pick the video output (1080p, 1440p or 4K).
  A new video output setting takes effect the next time you start the game.
- New home-screen icon, background art and music.
- The hidden debug menu works too. The last button in the code is a click on
  the left half of the touch pad.
- This is a first release, so expect some bugs. Please report them with
  "PS5" in the title.

name: 1.5.2 Test Build (PS Vita) - Entry Sync
body:
## BattleShip Vita 1.5.2 — AdHoc Entry Synchronization Test

**Experimental pre-release, based on 1.5.1.** Previous builds (`1.5.1` and `1.5-test`) remain available unchanged. Both PS Vitas must install **this same 1.5.2 VPK** before joining one AdHoc lobby.

### Changes vs 1.5.1

- **Deterministic fighter entry sequence in netplay.** The game previously selected one of three fighter entry timelines with a presentation-only random stream that is not synchronized across peers. This choice actually controls when fighter statuses change; in logs it correlates with the first fighter divergence at frames 120/144. AdHoc/modern netplay now selects sequence 0 on both consoles, while offline retains random presentation.
- **Guard null GObj in `gcMoveGObjDL`.** Prevents a CSS/display-list null-pointer crash and logs the unexpected call (rate-limited).
- **Guard missing animation keyframes in `syInterpGetFracFrame`.** Avoids a null-keyframe dereference observed during Vita coredump analysis; invalid animation data returns a safe fallback.
- Uses a distinct **netplay build ID `1.5.2`** to prevent connecting to incompatible previous test VPKs.

No experimental UDP-input-frontier or redundancy changes have been reintroduced. Rollback window and network packet scheduling are unchanged relative to 1.5.1.

### Test priority

1. **AdHoc 1v1**, on both Vitas, for several consecutive games. Confirm both logs show `[NETPLAY][DET] deterministic fighter entry focus=0` and no initial `FIRST PARTITION MISMATCH category=fighter0/fighter1`.
2. **Two humans + one CPU**; confirm character, actions and status stay synchronized.
3. **Two humans + two CPUs**; test again for early state divergence.

If a desync remains, please attach both `ssb64.log` files from the same session; if a Vita crashes, include the matching `psp2core*.psp2dmp` file. These guards are defensive, and real-hardware stability still requires testing.

### Assets

- `battleship.vpk` — Vita executable, built with ID `1.5.2`.
- `texture_pack_1x.zip` — lowest resource use.
- `texture_pack_1.5x.zip` — balanced quality/performance.
- `texture_pack_2x.zip` — highest texture quality, higher resource use.

Texture packs are unchanged from release 1.5.1. Install only one texture pack at a time.

### Source provenance

- BattleShip release branch: `release/1.5.2` (commit `bcdb83e8fc36e7c16a96d81113d70f3fbfbd32f6`).
- `decomp` submodule: `37dacfe57eb28dc9f7628a10dc3ceb6d603642ff` (same-named release branch).
- `libultraship` and `torch` pinned to their 1.5.1 commits. No in-progress Smash Remix modifications included.

body: # GoldenEye 007 for PS Vita 1.0 A native PS Vita port of GoldenEye 007 (Rare, 1997, Nintendo 64), built from the GoldenEye 007 PC port and the GoldenEye 007 decompilation. **You must supply your own US GoldenEye 007 ROM.** This release contains no ROM and no game assets. ## Features - The full single-player campaign: all 20 missions and the end credits - Runs at 60 fps. Busy scenes and big open levels can drop to around 40 fps. - Full music and sound effects - Vita controls with rebindable buttons - Vita Options menu (press Select) for graphics, HUD, crosshair, audio and control settings - In-game watch options work as on the N64 - Saves to the memory card, separate from the app, so updates never touch your save - Shaders are cached after the first time they compile, so stutters only happen once ## Installation You'll need a homebrew-enabled Vita (h-encore/HENkaku) with VitaShell installed. 1. In VitaShell, go to `ux0:data/` and create a folder named `GoldenEye007`. 2. Copy `GE007Vita.vpk` and your ROM into `ux0:data/GoldenEye007/`. The ROM must be the US version in `.z64` format, named `ge007.ntsc-final.z64` or `baserom.u.z64`. 3. Highlight `GE007Vita.vpk` in VitaShell and press **X** twice to install. 4. Launch GoldenEye 007 from the LiveArea. The first launch takes a while. The game converts the data it needs from your ROM and saves the result, so later launches are quick. ## Updating Install the new VPK over the old one the same way. Your save and settings stay put. ## Controls | Action | Button | |---|---| | Move | Left stick | | Look | Right stick | | Fire | R | | Aim | L | | Action (doors, switches, tank) | Cross | | Reload | Square | | Next weapon | Triangle | | Previous weapon | Circle | | Crouch / stand up | D-pad down / up | | Strafe left / right | D-pad left / right | | Pause | Start | | Vita Options | Select | In menus, Cross accepts and Circle goes back. Gameplay buttons can be changed in Vita Options > Input > Buttons. ## Files Everything lives in `ux0:data/GoldenEye007/`: - `ge007.eep`: your save - `ge007.ini`: settings - `log.txt`: log for the last session - `ge007.crash.log`: written if the game crashes If something goes wrong, open an issue and attach `log.txt` (and the crash log if there is one) with a note on what you were doing. ## Known issues - Glass on Facility is missing its reflection. - With Native widescreen on, the picture shows black bars on the sides. - The Control Style watch option is locked to one layout. ## Checksum SHA-256 for `GE007Vita.vpk` is in `GE007Vita.vpk.sha256`. ## Credits - jkdansereau: the GoldenEye 007 PC port this is built from - The GoldenEye 007 decompilation team - The Perfect Dark PC port team - Rinnegatamante: vitaGL - The VitaSDK team - kaziema: PS Vita port - Testing: vizer, midnightneon (mano), mikey, saturn, ben

debug_logging=0

name: Real Racing 2 Public beta v1.0.0
body:
REAL RACING 2 - PS VITA (PORT) - PUBLIC BETA 2
==============================================

REQUIREMENTS
- PS Vita with HENkaku / Enso and VitaShell.
- The Android v851 game data (MALI variant) copied to ux0:data/rr2/
  (the first time you open the game the files are prepared; it can take a few minutes).

INSTALLATION
1. Copy RR2Vita_Public_Beta_1.0.0.vpk to the memory card and install it with VitaShell.
   If you have Beta 1 installed, install it on top: your save is kept.
2. Open Real Racing 2 from its bubble.


WHAT'S NEW SINCE PUBLIC BETA 1
------------------------------

CONFIGURATOR (new)
- Separate settings app: CONFIGURAR button in the LiveArea.
  (The configurator is in Spanish for now.)
- Graphics:
  · Anti-aliasing (MSAA): Off / 2x / 4x (experimental).
  · FPS cap: 30 or 60.
- Controls:
  · One button per action: accelerate, brake, pause, camera, look back and back in menus
    (it warns you if two actions use the same button).
  · Steer with: left stick, D-pad (steering increases gradually while you hold it), stick and D-pad,
    or tilting the console.
  · Steering sensitivity, stick dead zone, invert direction and on-screen pointer on/off.
- System:
  · Save and play, save and exit, default values.
  · Game data uninstaller (before deleting anything, it copies your save to ux0:data/RR2_partida_guardada).

PERFORMANCE AND GRAPHICS
- Smoother: the game no longer waits for the screen refresh on every frame. On the heaviest tracks
  the average goes from ~47 to ~56 FPS and the drops to 22 FPS are gone.
- More memory for graphics (PS Vita extended memory mode): no more cars with purple textures or
  glitches in menus and dialogs on the big tracks.
- Lighter build: without the debugging tools of the test builds.

CONTROLS
- The game goes back to control method B on every launch, even if the saved profile comes with
  another method (for example, downloaded data) or you change it in the game options.

GAME
- You can now change the driver name: the game's option opens the PS Vita keyboard
  (accents and ñ included). When you accept, the name is typed into the game automatically.

PRESENTATION
- New boot screen (the screen used to stay black).
- LiveArea with the CONFIGURAR button.

STABILITY
- If the game closes because of an internal error, it is recorded in ux0:data/rr2/live_debug.log.
- The log records the settings used on each launch (useful for bug reports).


DEFAULT CONTROLS
----------------
- Left stick: steer (or the D-pad, depending on the configurator).
- R: accelerate.                  L: brake.
- Triangle: change camera.        Circle or D-pad down: look back.
- START: pause.                   Circle in menus: back.
- Menus and pause: the stick moves the pointer and Cross taps (SELECT centers it).
- START + SELECT: quit the game.


KNOWN BUGS
----------
- The crowd is not visible.
- On the heaviest tracks there are still moments below 60 FPS: the limit is the PS Vita CPU.
  If you prefer stability, set the 30 FPS cap in the configurator.
- MSAA 4x is experimental: it uses more video memory.
- Some screens have the back button in a different position: there Circle does nothing (use the
  pointer or the touch screen).
- The controls only work with the game's control method B (that's why the game goes back to B on
  every launch).


PLANNED FOR NEXT VERSIONS
-------------------------
- Adapt the game's other control methods (A, C, D and E) to the PS Vita buttons.
- Keep improving performance on the heaviest tracks.
- Check that the pointer can be used on the results screen at the end of a race.
- Make Circle also work on screens with the back button in a different position.


##############################################################################
#  ESPAÑOL
##############################################################################

REAL RACING 2 - PS VITA (PORT) - PUBLIC BETA 2
==============================================

REQUISITOS
- PS Vita con HENkaku / Enso y VitaShell.
- Los datos del juego de Android v851 (variante MALI) copiados en ux0:data/rr2/
  (la primera vez que abras el juego se preparan los archivos; puede tardar unos minutos).

INSTALACIÓN
1. Copia RR2Vita_Public_Beta_1.0.0.vpk a la tarjeta e instálalo con VitaShell.
   Si tienes la Beta 1 instalada, instálalo encima: se conserva tu partida.
2. Abre Real Racing 2 desde la burbuja.


NOVEDADES DESDE LA PUBLIC BETA 1
--------------------------------

CONFIGURADOR (nuevo)
- Aplicación de ajustes aparte: botón CONFIGURAR en la LiveArea, o mantén SELECT al abrir el juego.
- Gráficos:
  · Suavizado de bordes (MSAA): No / 2x / 4x (experimental).
  · Tope de FPS: 30 o 60.
- Controles:
  · Un botón para cada acción: acelerar, frenar, pausa, cámara, mirar atrás y atrás en los menús
    (avisa si dos acciones usan el mismo botón).
  · Girar con: stick izquierdo, cruceta (el giro aumenta poco a poco al mantenerla), stick y cruceta,
    o inclinando la consola.
  · Sensibilidad del giro, zona muerta del stick, invertir dirección y flecha en pantalla sí/no.
- Sistema:
  · Guardar y jugar, guardar y salir, valores por defecto.
  · Desinstalador de los datos del juego (antes de borrar, copia tu partida a ux0:data/RR2_partida_guardada).

RENDIMIENTO Y GRÁFICOS
- Más fluidez: el juego ya no espera al refresco de pantalla en cada fotograma. En las pistas más
  pesadas la media sube de ~47 a ~56 FPS y desaparecen las caídas a 22 FPS.
- Más memoria para los gráficos (modo de memoria ampliada de la Vita): se acabaron los coches con
  texturas moradas y los fallos en menús y diálogos de las pistas grandes.
- Versión más ligera: sin las herramientas de depuración de las versiones de prueba.

CONTROLES
- El juego vuelve al método de control B en cada arranque, aunque el perfil guardado traiga otro
  método (por ejemplo, datos descargados) o lo cambies en las opciones del juego.

JUEGO
- Ya se puede cambiar el nombre del piloto: la opción del juego abre el teclado de la Vita
  (con tildes y ñ). Al aceptar, el nombre se escribe solo en el juego.

PRESENTACIÓN
- Nueva imagen de arranque (antes la pantalla se quedaba en negro).
- LiveArea con el botón CONFIGURAR.

ESTABILIDAD
- Si el juego se cierra por un error interno, queda registrado en ux0:data/rr2/live_debug.log.
- El log anota la configuración usada en cada arranque (útil para reportar fallos).


CONTROLES POR DEFECTO
---------------------
- Stick izquierdo: girar (o la cruceta, según el configurador).
- R: acelerar.                    L: frenar.
- Triángulo: cambiar cámara.      Círculo o cruceta abajo: mirar atrás.
- START: pausa.                   Círculo en los menús: volver.
- Menús y pausa: el stick mueve la flecha y la Cruz pulsa (SELECT la centra).
- START + SELECT: salir del juego.


BUGS CONOCIDOS
--------------
- El público de las gradas no se ve (las texturas de la tribuna salen vacías).
- En las pistas más pesadas todavía hay momentos por debajo de 60 FPS: el límite es la CPU de la Vita.
  Si prefieres estabilidad, pon el tope de 30 FPS en el configurador.
- MSAA 4x es experimental: usa más memoria de vídeo.
- Algunas pantallas tienen el botón de volver en otra posición: ahí Círculo no hace nada (usa la flecha
  o el táctil).
- Los controles solo funcionan con el método de control B del juego (por eso el juego vuelve a B en
  cada arranque).


PENDIENTE PARA PRÓXIMAS VERSIONES
---------------------------------
- Adaptar los demás métodos de control del juego (A, C, D y E) a los botones de la Vita.
- Seguir mejorando el rendimiento en las pistas más pesadas.
- Comprobar que la flecha se puede usar en la pantalla de resultados al terminar la carrera.
- Que el botón Círculo funcione también en las pantallas con el botón de volver en otra posición.

name: Brothers in Arms 2: Global Front HD Vita v1.0
body:
# Brothers in Arms 2: Global Front HD Vita v1.0

This is a wrapper/port of **Brothers in Arms 2: Global Front HD** (Gameloft) for the PlayStation Vita and PlayStation TV.

## Changelog

- **v1.0 — Initial Release**:
  - **Full 3D Gameplay**: Runs smoothly on the PS Vita using hardware-accelerated GLES rendering via [vitaGL](https://github.com/Rinnegatamante/vitaGL).
  - **Blue Textures Fixed**: ATC textures are transcoded block-by-block to DXT1 / DXT3 / DXT5 (`source/reimpl/atc.c`) with the proper channel order, fixing the blue skin and blue rifle textures while keeping textures compressed in VRAM.
  - **Performance**: vitaGL CPU speedhacks from N.O.V.A 2 (`MATH_SPEEDHACK`, `SAMPLERS_SPEEDHACK`), cached vitaGL RAM pool, compressed textures and trampoline hooks for the HUD dimming (no code patching on every HUD draw).
  - **Full Dual-Analog Physical Controls**:
    - **Left Stick / D-Pad**: Move soldier.
    - **Right Stick**: Smooth, unlimited 360° camera with continuous drag and velocity curves.
    - **R / RTRIGGER / R1**: Fire weapon (hold).
    - **L / LTRIGGER / L1**: Iron sights / Aim (toggle).
    - **Cross**: Context action (climb obstacles, jump, vehicle interaction).
    - **Circle**: Run / dash (hold in game; Back in menus -- no longer opens the pause menu).
    - **Select**: Shake (melee "SHAKE" prompts); the real accelerometer works too.
    - **Square**: Change stance (Stand / Crouch / Prone).
    - **Triangle**: Switch weapon / Reload.
    - **Start**: Pause game / Open menu.
  - **Bottom Virtual Buttons Dimmed to 1%**: Bottom on-screen buttons (move joystick, fire, aim, run, stance) are rendered at 1% opacity while remaining touch-interactive; the top HUD (pause button, weapon panel) keeps its normal opacity.
  - **Main Menu Background Restored**: fixed a hook that made the menu background render black.
  - **Smooth Camera Sensitivity**: Adjust camera look speed on the fly with **Select + D-Pad Up / Down** (levels 1–10). An on-screen visual indicator appears, and settings are saved to `ux0:data/brothersinarms2/camera_sens.txt`.
  - **Intro Video Playback**: Unconverted `intro.mp4` (H.264 Baseline + AAC) plays on boot using the PS Vita's hardware video decoder (`sceAvcdec`) and software AAC audio decoding via FFmpeg (`libavcodec`). Can be skipped anytime with **Cross** or **Start**.
  - **Audio System**: Custom 48 kHz stereo mixer routing sound effects and Vorbis OGG music to `sceAudioOut`.
  - **Data Paths**: Remapped all save and asset directories to `ux0:data/brothersinarms2/`.

---

## Setup Instructions

To run this port, you must supply assets from a legally obtained copy of the Android game:

1. Ensure [**kubridge**](https://github.com/TheOfficialFloW/kubridge/releases) and [**FdFix**](https://github.com/TheOfficialFloW/FdFix/releases) are installed on your PS Vita (`ur0:tai/config.txt` under `*KERNEL`).
2. Ensure [**libshacccg.suprx**](https://github.com/Rinnegatamante/ShaRKBR33D/releases/latest) is installed in `ur0:data/`.
3. Obtain the original APK of **Brothers in Arms 2: Global Front HD v1.0.4** (`Brothers_In_Arms_2__Global_Front_HD_1.0.4.apk`) and its data cache folder (`BIA2/`).
4. Extract the `.apk` using any zip archive tool on your PC.
5. Copy `lib/armeabi-v7a/libbia2.so` from inside the APK to `ux0:data/brothersinarms2/libbia2.so`.
6. Copy the APK's `res/raw/` directory contents to `ux0:data/brothersinarms2/res/raw/`.
7. Copy the complete `BIA2/` data cache folder (`intro.mp4`, `sprites/`, `sounds/`, `gui/`, etc.) to `ux0:data/brothersinarms2/BIA2/`.
8. Install `brothersinarms2.vpk` on your PS Vita using **VitaShell**.
9. Launch the game from your LiveArea.

### Directory Layout on Memory Card

```text
ux0:data/brothersinarms2/
├── libbia2.so            <- Extracted from lib/armeabi-v7a/ in the APK
├── BIA2/                 <- Android data cache folder (gameloft/games/bia2)
│   ├── intro.mp4         <- Boot intro video
│   ├── sprites/
│   ├── sounds/
│   ├── fonts/
│   └── gui/
├── res/
│   └── raw/              <- Extracted from res/raw/ in the APK (raw_000.ogg, etc.)
├── saves/                <- Created automatically by the game
├── logs/                 <- Debug logs (brothersinarms2_NNN.log)
└── camera_sens.txt       <- Camera sensitivity setting file
```

---

## Controls Reference

- **Left Stick** — Move soldier
- **Right Stick** — Camera look / Aim (light tilt = precise aim, full tilt = fast turn)
- **R / R1 / RTRIGGER** — Fire weapon (hold)
- **L / L1 / LTRIGGER** — Aim / Iron sights (toggle)
- **Cross** — Context action (jump, climb, interact)
- **Circle** — Run / dash (hold in game; Back in menus)
- **Select** — Shake (melee "SHAKE" prompts; shaking the console also works)
- **Square** — Change stance (Stand / Crouch / Prone)
- **Triangle** — Switch weapon / Reload
- **Start** — Pause / Menu
- **Select + D-Pad Up / Down** — Adjust camera sensitivity (1 to 10)
- **D-Pad (without Select)** — Move soldier / Navigate menus
- **Touch Screen** — Touch controls (still responsive; bottom buttons at 1% opacity)

---

## Troubleshooting

- **Error dialog on boot saying data files are missing:**
  Ensure `ux0:data/brothersinarms2/libbia2.so` is present and that `ux0:data/brothersinarms2/BIA2/` contains the cache files.
- **Crash on startup or black screen:**
  Verify that `kubridge.skprx` and `fd_fix.skprx` are loaded under `*KERNEL` in `ur0:tai/config.txt`, and that `ur0:data/libshacccg.suprx` is present.
- **If an issue occurs:**
  Check the latest log created in `ux0:data/brothersinarms2/logs/brothersinarms2_NNN.log`.

---

## Credits

- **Gameloft & Gearbox Software** for the original game.
- **TheFloW** for `so_util`, `kubridge`, and `FdFix`.
- **Rinnegatamante** for `vitaGL`.
- **v-atamanenko** for `FalsoJNI` and `soloader-boilerplate`.
- **Wonder Diaz** for porting, reverse engineering, controls mapping, and optimization for PS Vita.

name: Sacred Odyssey: Rise of Ayden — PS Vita Port — v1.0.2
body:
# Sacred Odyssey: Rise of Ayden — PS Vita Port — Release Notes

## v1.0.2 (2026-09-29)

- **Fix crash in World 10 / introductory cutscenes:**
  - Fixed a critical `Data abort exception (0x30004)` occurring during the introductory horse cutscene (`HorseWhite_5017`, `MCInCutScene_6520`) when loading World 10 (`mc_animation_cutscenes.bdae`).
  - The crash was caused by the loader's missing texture redirect (`KnightsOdyssey_hand2_diffuse.tga` -> `KnightsOdyssey_hand_diffuse.kot`) returning an already-cached `fcache` in-memory handle (`FCacheHandle*`) without an early return, causing the outer `fopen` logic to pass the fake handle to `SceLibc` (`sceLibcBridge_setvbuf` / `fcache_populate` -> `sceLibcBridge_fseek`).
  - Added immediate returns (`return ret;`) to all asset redirects in `fopen_soloader` and guarded the buffer setup against `fcache` handles (`!fcache_is_handle(ret)`).
- **Reworked Right Analog Stick Camera (NOVA 2 / Shadow Guardian style):**
  - **Eliminated sudden camera snaps/resets:** previously, the camera coordinates were only reset in the axis hook when deflected. When the player released the stick, the hook was never called, leaving the accumulator frozen at 500.0f; on the next movement, the engine rotated `lastCamDir` by an instant 333° snap. Accumulation and centering reset now run unconditionally in `controls_update()` every frame.
  - **Fluid 360° rotation without freezing:** horizontal rotation now wraps smoothly at 4π (1080.0f units, matching the quaternion `fromAngleAxis` period), allowing continuous 360-degree rotation forever.
  - **Quadratic analog deadzone curve:** implemented standard `0.15f` deadzone with quadratic response (`0.35f * t + 0.65f * t^2`) for precision aiming and smooth full-stick pans.
  - **Customizable sensitivity:** loads optional sensitivity setting from `ux0:data/sacredodyssey/camera_sens.txt` (1..10, default 5).

---

## Installation

1. Install the generated `.vpk` (`build/sacredodyssey.vpk`) with VitaShell.
2. From the original Android install, copy the following to `ux0:data/sacredodyssey/` on the Vita:
   ```text
   ux0:data/sacredodyssey/
   ├── libsacredodyssey.so
   ├── res/            (drawable, layout, raw)
   └── GloftSOHP/
       └── data/       (3d, 2d, audio, menus, automat, ...)
   ```
3. Requires `kubridge.skprx` and `libshacccg.suprx` installed (see [`README.md`](README.md) for the
   full requirements).
4. Launch the game — the first run creates its own saves/logs under
   `ux0:data/sacredodyssey/saves/` and `ux0:data/sacredodyssey/logs/`.

This repository does **not** distribute the APK, the `.so`, or the game's assets (see `.gitignore`) —
you need your own legitimate copy of Sacred Odyssey: Rise of Ayden.

## Credits

- **Sacred Odyssey: Rise of Ayden** and its engine (Gameloft Glitch) are property of **Gameloft** —
  this repository makes no claim of authorship over the original game.
- **Andy "TheFloW" Nguyen** for the original Android `.so` loader concept.
- **Rinnegatamante** for [vitaGL](https://github.com/Rinnegatamante/vitaGL).
- **Volodymyr Atamanenko** for the soloader boilerplate and FalsoJNI.

## License

This port's code is MIT-licensed (see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)). The game and its assets remain the
property of Gameloft and are not distributed in this repository.

name: Animal Crossing Vita v0.5.0
body:
## Animal Crossing Vita v0.5.0 Multiplayer Update

Up to 4 players in one town: the host and 3 visitors, all playing at the same time. You travel by train through Porter, like the old card trips.

- Talk to Porter, go on a trip, then pick **Visit a friend.** or **Have visitors.**
- Three ways to connect:
  - **Right beside me!** Vita local wireless, no router needed.
  - **On my Wi-Fi.** Same network, finds open towns by itself.
  - **Far away.** Internet. The host gets an 8-character ticket number to hand out.
- Far away, the host's Vita opens UDP port 19520 on the router itself (NAT-PMP, then UPnP). If the router refuses it or keeps it for another device, it tries 19521-19523. Only the host needs a port. Behind CGNAT you can't host far away, but you can still visit.
- Shared between screens: players, villagers, bugs and fish, weather and clock, events, the train and Porter, items, rooms, the island cottage and NES games. (If you find anything missing let me know!!)
- Chat: speech balloons over heads. Tap the balloon in the bottom left, 32 characters, GameCube or Vita keyboard. Typing shows as dots. Messages from players off screen show at the screen edge facing them, or over the building they're in.
- New Online page: Title screen > Options > Online. Chat on/off, keyboard, what visitors can do, and asking before visitors join. The host's settings are the ones that count in their town.
- Saves stay normal GameCube .gci files. While you're visiting, your character is also kept in `mp_passport_*` files next to your save. Don't delete them mid-trip.
- Items you pick up in someone's town are only yours once the host's game has saved them, so nothing gets duplicated.
- Everyone needs the same release.

Not shared yet: Kapp'n's boat ride (everyone keeps their own boat), where Nook and Mable stand in shops, events waiting for a host who's in a menu or talk, and how clean Gracie's car looks.

Details, ports and troubleshooting are in `vita/MULTIPLAYER.md`. Back up your saves before playing online. And be careful who you share your info with!

## Fixes

- Many small visual bugs fixed
- Resetti menu background fixed
- Dpad spam doesnt play last action anymore
- NES games not working for some users, and optional path for roms in settings.ini
- Version number on main menu

## Security

- Blocked known text and save exploits: control codes in passwords, bulletin board posts and names; message and choice overflows; NES card game overflows. The host also cleans text coming in from visitors.

Note: Please be careful who you share your IP with, I am not responsible for bad actors. Please use at your own risk, and respect other players.

## Trophies

- While you're visiting, only your own progress counts.

## Modding

- Initial framework for multiplayer sync API (mods). Joining checks that everyone runs the same gameplay mods.

name: Asphalt 5 HD - PS Vita Port v1.2.0
body:
# Asphalt 5 HD - PS Vita Port (v1.2.0) 🏎️💨

**Asphalt 5** for PS Vita is fully playable from start to finish with physical controls, full
audio and cutscene video.

### 🆕 What's new in v1.2.0
Fixes for the issues reported on GitHub after v1.0 — thanks for the reports!
* **The left analog stick now steers** (and moves Up/Down in menus), exactly like the D-Pad. The
  stick was never switched to analog mode, so it always read as centered.
* **No more crackling in the main menu and results screen.** The mixer no longer jumps the music
  volume every time a UI sound starts or stops. Music volume fades are smooth, stopped sounds fade
  out in ~5 ms instead of being cut mid-wave, and the limiter no longer flattens music peaks.
  Mixing now runs at 44.1 kHz, an exact 2x of the game's 22 kHz sounds, for a cleaner sound. The
  Sound Options menu no longer restarts the song on every frame.
* **The "You Win / You Lose" banner can be skipped** with a tap, ❌, Start or ⭕. You no longer
  have to wait for it to go away on its own.
* **Post-race reporter video no longer freezes** for a couple of seconds at the start. Audio and
  video packets are now read in time order.
* **Smoother frame rate in races.** Diagnostic logging written to the memory card on every sound
  start and stick movement caused frame hitches. It's gone from the hot paths.

This port uses a custom Android wrapper (soLoader/FalsoJNI) to run the original ARMv6 Android
executable natively on the Vita, fully hardware-accelerated via `vitaGL`.

### ✨ Features
* **Full physical controls.** A custom input router bridges the Vita's buttons with the game's
  native touch engine. It only works with the **Touch Buttons** control scheme, which is set
  automatically on a fresh install.
  * **Menus:** **D-Pad** or **Left Analog Stick** (Up/Down). **❌ (Cross)** selects, **⭕ (Circle)**
    goes back.
  * **"You Win / You Lose" banner:** tap, **❌**, **Start** or **⭕** to skip it.
  * **Title screens:** any face button skips.
  * **Racing:**
    * **D-Pad Left/Right, L/R Triggers, or Left Analog Stick** to steer.
    * **❌ (Cross)** for nitro.
    * **🟥 (Square)** to brake / drift.
    * **Start** to pause.
    * **Select** to show / hide the on-screen brake & nitro icons.
* **Custom audio engine.** A 32-bit fixed-point mixer with linear interpolation at 44.1 kHz. It
  follows the engine's routing: looped engine and skid sounds track RPM live, music has a
  dedicated voice that SFX can't steal, and a soft limiter keeps busy scenes clean.
* **Hardware-accelerated graphics** via `vitaGL`.
* **Post-race flow.** The win/lose banner and the results screens advance with a tap or ❌. Held race inputs are released
  cleanly at the state change.

### ⚠️ Known Issues
* Only the **Touch Buttons** control scheme works with physical controls. Don't switch to Tilt or
  the drag schemes in Options.
* Manual standby (power button sleep/resume mid-game) is untested. Idling is safe.
* Heavy tracks may drop a few frames at busy moments.
* The intro trailer needs its `.mp4` in `ux0:data/asphalt5/data/`. Otherwise it's skipped.

### 🛠️ Installation Instructions
1. Install `libshacccg.suprx` if you don't have it already (required for vitaGL).
2. Install the provided `asphalt5.vpk`.
3. Extract the game data files (assets) into `ux0:data/asphalt5/`. *(Data files are not
   provided with this release. You must extract them from your own legally obtained copy of the
   Android game.)*
4. Launch the game and enjoy!

---
*A huge thanks to the PS Vita homebrew community and the vitaGL contributors for making this possible! Let us know your feedback and bug reports.*

name: Gangstar Miami Vindication - PS Vita Port 0.2.0 Beta
body:
# Gangstar Miami Vindication (PS Vita)

## v0.64.0-alpha — 2026-09-27 (Fase 64, current)

VPK: `build/gangstarmiamivindication.vpk` (built with `psvita-toolkit build --preset release`).

### What's new since v0.63.0
- **Performance & GPU Memory (VRAM / RAM)**:
  * Eliminated the critical `Circular pool #2 spilled into VRAM` regression by tuning `_newlib_heap_size_user` from 256 MB down to 192 MB. vitaGL now receives over 140 MB of RAM, fitting all 3 circular pool buffers completely into RAM with zero spill into VRAM (recovering >21 MB of pure VRAM).
  * Solved the 4.3-second freezes / FPS drops (`gpu_alloc_mapped_aligned failed with a requested size of 4194304 bytes` and 4-cycle GC stalls) when driving near mission triggers, by ensuring large 4 MB textures have ample contiguous memory in RAM and VRAM.
  * Added `sceUserMainThreadStackSize = 4 * 1024 * 1024` (4 MB stack) for deep recursion and fast streaming in vehicles.
- **Animation Streaming**:
  * Resolved `CAnimationStreamingManager::Instance` and expanded its memory cache limit from 384 KB (`0x60000`) to 2 MB (`0x200000`), ending cache thrashing, evictions, and warning chatter when loading dense mission areas with animated cutscene triggers and NPCs.
- **Input & Sound I/O Optimization**:
  * Demoted all per-event touch/stick/wheel logs in `gamepad_actions.c` to `l_debug` (compiled out in Release), eliminating up to 100 ms/sec of blocking synchronous disk writes to `ux0:` during active steering, sprinting, or shooting.
  * Filtered out `DeviceKeyInput`, `stopRadio`, `SOUNDS-VV`, `----Gameloft----`, and `AnimationStreamingManager` chatter from disk writes in `reimpl/log.c`.
- **Rendering Stability**:
  * Diagnosed and avoided the `libmathneon.a` softfp bug in `cosf_neon_sfp` (which caused the total black screen in `debug_local_063.log`), preserving standard rock-solid newlib math and 100% rendering integrity.

### Confirmed on hardware (logs 063–064 + user testing)
- Fluidity significantly improved after removing synchronous input logging (`debug_local_064.log`).
- Rendering 100% restored after reverting `libmathneon` softfp wrappers (no black screen).
- Buttons at 1% opacity and steering wheel control confirmed working.
- Everything from v0.63.0 (intro video, character rendering, radio stability) fully functional.

### Known errors in this release
1. Initial 0.5–16 s shader/texture bursts at title and first vehicle/area load (settles via on-disk shader cache).
2. ~8 s engine `PostInit` stall after intro video.
3. City pop-in still present at distant horizon (streaming radius 8000 / far 15000).
4. No suspend/resume or accelerometer lifecycle hooks wired yet.

---

## Earlier phases
See [`port_progress.md`](port_progress.md) (bug-by-bug log, Fases 1–60) and git history.
No packaged releases precede this file; day-to-day testing used undeployed `eboot.bin` drops.

name: Shadow Guardian Vita v1.4
body:
# Shadow Guardian Vita v1.4

This is a wrapper/port of **Shadow Guardian HD** for the PS Vita.

## Changelog

- v1.4: Ultra-fluid camera overhaul, in-game sensitivity OSD, and HUD polish:
  - **Eliminated camera micro-pauses during 360° turns.** The previous camera implementation relied on an artificial 110px bounding box that triggered synthetic `ACTION_UP` and `ACTION_DOWN` cycles. Decompilation revealed that `StartFreeCamera` reset camera inertia (`0.25f`) and produced 0-delta frames on every wrap, creating noticeable stutters during rotations. Drag is now 100% continuous while the stick is deflected, resulting in completely uninterrupted 60 FPS camera rotation.
  - **In-game camera sensitivity adjustment (1–10) with OSD bar.** Sensitivity can now be adjusted in real time during gameplay using **SELECT + D-Pad Up / Down**. The setting is saved persistently to `ux0:data/shadowguardian/camera_sens.txt` and displays a clean 10-block on-screen indicator bar.
  - **HUD virtual weapon selector & aim button polish.** The virtual weapon icon (top-right) is kept at 100% opacity without forcing visibility on every sub-element, allowing the engine's internal `UpdateWeaponGUI` to cleanly display only the currently active weapon without graphical overlap. The redundant touch aim button (bottom-right) and virtual joystick are cleanly hidden.
  - **Select button dual-mode.** Tapping SELECT toggles virtual on-screen touch controls on release, without conflicting with SELECT + D-Pad sensitivity combos.

## Setup Instructions

In order to properly install the game, you'll need to extract the data from the original Android game.

1. Install the `kubridge` and `fd_fix` plugins on your PS Vita.
2. Install `libshacccg.suprx`, if you don't have it already, by following [this guide](https://samilops2.gitbook.io/vita-troubleshooting-guide/shader-compiler/extract-libshacccg.suprx).
3. Obtain the original APK of Shadow Guardian (`Shadow-Guardian-HD-v1-0-1-UK-RU.apk`) and the required data files.
4. Extract the `.apk` using any zip extractor.
5. Place the executable `libshadowguardian.so` (from `lib/armeabi-v7a/` inside the APK) in `ux0:data/shadowguardian/`. (If the APK also contains `libStormGLOFT.so`, you can copy it too — it does no harm.)
6. Place all game asset folders (`res`, `shaders`, `textures`, `models`, `music`, `sounds`, etc.) in `ux0:data/shadowguardian/`.
7. Make sure the 16:9 assets `sprites_1_7` and `gui_1_7` are present. If the APK only ships the `sprites_1_6` / `gui_1_6` variants, duplicate them with VitaShell (Copy + Paste + Rename) so the `_1_7` names exist — missing 16:9 GUI assets can crash the game on the LOADING screen. Also confirm the `res/` folder was copied.
8. Double-check that `gui_1_6` and `sprites_1_6` themselves are also present in `ux0:data/shadowguardian/` (not just the `_1_7` copies) — some assets are only ever requested by their `_1_6` name at runtime, and a copy missing just these two files can pass every other check and still crash later during gameplay.
9. Download and install `shadowguardian.vpk` on your PS Vita.

## Controls

- **Left Analog** - Movement (in-game only)
- **Right Analog** - Camera (free-look, continuous drag — smooth quadratic curve, sub-pixel precision, no stutter)
- **Select + D-Pad Up / Down** - Adjust camera sensitivity (1–10, saved to `camera_sens.txt` with OSD bar)
- **D-Pad** - Menu Navigation / Movement
- **R / R1** - Fire
- **L / L1** - Aim (hold)
- **Cross** - Contextual action (jump / run / climb)
- **Circle** - Grab / interact
- **Square** - Switch weapon (synthetic swipe)
- **Start** - Pause / Back
- **Select (tap)** - Toggle Virtual Buttons (Hide/Show touch controls)
- **Touch Screen** - Original Touch Controls

## Known Issues

- A blue highlight/glow effect shown specifically when switching weapons may still appear even with the touch controls hidden — the generic `HighlightButton` hook covers the button-prompt glow, but the weapon-change flash may come from a separate effect. Please report it with a log/screenshot of the exact moment it happens.

## Troubleshooting

**Crash on the LOADING screen (`C2-12828-1` error):** this is usually a data setup problem, not a game bug. Check the following with VitaShell:

1. You installed the **latest** `shadowguardian.vpk` (older builds have known crashes that are already fixed).
2. `kubridge` and `fd_fix` plugins plus `libshacccg.suprx` are installed (see Setup above).
3. In `ux0:data/shadowguardian/`: `libshadowguardian.so`, the `res/` folder, and all asset folders are present, and **both** the `_1_6` and `_1_7` variants of `sprites` and `gui` exist (`sprites_1_6`, `sprites_1_7`, `gui_1_6`, `gui_1_7`) — copy whichever ones are missing from the variant you do have. As of v1.2.3, a missing `gui_1_6`/`gui_1_7` or `sprites_1_6`/`sprites_1_7` shows a clear "missing game data files" dialog on boot instead of crashing later — if you see that dialog, it's telling you exactly which one to fix.

**If it still crashes**, please report it with:

1. The newest `ux0:data/shadowguardian/logs/game_log_*.txt` (from the time of the crash — do not delete it).
2. The newest `ux0:data/psp2core-*-eboot.bin.psp2dmp` core dump.
3. A note on exactly when it happens (on boot, which level loading, do you ever reach the menu?).
